name: Indag Rubber Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1978, INDAG Rubber Ltd manufactures and sells Precured Tread Rubber and allied products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Founded in 1978 as a joint venture between the Khemka Group and Bandag Inc. (USA), the company later came under full control of the Khemka Group. It specializes in tyre retreading solutions, offering a cost-effective alternative to new tyres by supplying retreading materials and services across India for M&HCVs, LCVs, passenger vehicles, and off-road vehicles.

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.11% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.10.8 Cr.
